reason: My register has never stopped working on a Sunday and I know every bill in it. Paying ₹4,999 and then ₹999 every month so my girls take selfies and type numbers into an English app, during festival rush, is more trouble than help for my small parlour.
objection: When the phone hangs or the app stops on a busy Sunday with the chairs full, who will come and fix it? My register never needs a helpline, and some of my staff are not comfortable with English apps.
would_change_my_mind: If another parlour owner I know nearby used it for a full festival season without trouble, and they gave a Hindi option and a local person who comes the same day when it breaks.
